limitations: The rational-ratio search is finite and cannot certify all real q.
Representative interval diagnostics use height-one first-default subtrees.
Full terminal-table outcomes are not enumerated; distinct terminal addresses are checked for sampled selector completions.
Novelty, significance, and independent Reviewer approval are not inferred from these checks.

uniform_verification.parameters: All real 0<q,p<1; c=4/(1-q), k=(M-1)*r; no rational or dyadic restriction on q.
uniform_verification.coverage: Actual finite tables, derived selector and adaptive-terminal address injectivity, completion-uniform representatives, stable-key routing transfer, and normalized positive-atom conditional probability.
uniform_verification.boundary: The original preorder-window realization of the deterministic endpoint interface is proved in proof.md and remains an explicit ledger dependency, not a Lean-constructed window family.
uniform_verification.independent_review: required; not supplied by this certificate
